findings.title: SQL disable helper always returns false but still dereferences FeatureToggles
findings.body: pkg/expr/reader.go:195 defines enableSqlExpressions() as `enabled := !h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(...)` followed by `if enabled { return false }; return false`, so it always returns false. The feature-flag read is dead code with inverted logic, but it still dereferences h/h.features. Any SQL expression query with a nil reader or nil FeatureToggles (tests, minimal wiring) now panics instead of returning the intended 'not implemented' error, where the old SQL path never touched features. It also invites a future 'cleanup' of the inversion that silently re-enables CVE-2024-9264. It should just return false with a security comment and no flag read.

findings.title: Legacy SQL path not explicitly disabled, bypasses new reader gate
findings.body: pkg/expr/sql_command.go:25 NewSQLCommand() and :51 UnmarshalSQLCommand() have no disabled/feature check; only pkg/expr/reader.go:128-132 rejects SQL expressions. The old rawNode path is therefore blocked only incidentally because pkg/expr/sql/db.go is now a stub returning errors. That is single-point, fragile defense: any future fix to the stub, alternate constructor, or direct caller restores DuckDB RCE/LFI via the legacy path. Both NewSQLCommand and UnmarshalSQLCommand should fail fast with an explicit 'sql expressions disabled for security' error instead of attempting TablesList/QueryFramesInto.

findings.title: Stub DB uses generic 'not implemented' hiding security disable
findings.body: pkg/expr/sql/db.go:12-26 replaces the DuckDB backend with type DB and methods TablesList/RunCommands/QueryFramesInto that all return generic errors.New('not implemented'), and keeps the constructor name NewInMemoryDB(). A maintainer reading only this file sees a TODO to implement rather than an intentional security disable for CVE-2024-9264, risking reintroduction of the vulnerable DuckDB dependency. Errors are also indistinguishable from transient failures and, in sql_command.go Execute, become rsp.Error with nil Go error. Return an explicit disabled error referencing the CVE and comment why it must stay disabled.
